knowledge_point.title: Using Column Operations to Create a Row of Zeros in a 4x4 Matrix

question.:question/problem:
$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}-7 & 4 & 7 & -6 \\ -10 & 4 & 6 & 2 \\ 4 & 3 & -8 & 8 \\ 6 & -8 & -1 & 1\end{bmatrix},\,B=\begin{bmatrix}-37 & 16 & 25 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2 \\ 44 & -13 & -32 & 8 \\ 11 & -10 & -4 & 1\end{bmatrix}
$$

Consider the matrices $A$ and $B$ above. By applying three matrix elementary column operations

- $C_{1}:=C_{1}+5C_{4}$
- $C_{2}:=\ldots$
- $C_{3}:=\ldots$

each of the form $C_i:=C_i+kC_{4},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the missing elementary column operations?
